name: Speed vs Giant
desc:
Welcome to Speed Vs Giant! 👋

How to play:
🏃 Run away from the Giant and avoid obstacles!
💰 Earn Cash and Buy Speed to Run faster!
🏆 Collect pets to boost your earnings and unlock new worlds with wins!

❗Hit Like & Get Instant Rewards❗
🔥 Cool Parrot Pet
💰 +3000 Cash

Credits to Interbyte Studios for creating some of the pet models used in this game.
